_readme: 6 commodity underlyings -- CONFIRMED as the correct, final list for this master (user explicitly chose this narrow curated set over frontend/src/mcx.json's broader 18-entry list, which includes non-micro contracts this app does not track). No fixed spot symbol exists for any commodity (confirmed earlier in this project) -- 'symbol' here is the bare exchange:root string used as the fetchOptionChain lookup key, ATM is computed off each commodity's own near-month futures price instead, not spot.
